data.name: Tripping Staff (Mythic)
data.description: Your staff is valuable for attack and defensive balance.

raw_tokens.value: Your staff is valuable for attack and defensive balance.

You add +%1 to CMD against trip maneuvers and on combat maneuver checks to trip with a quarterstaff. When you're wielding a quarterstaff and an opponent you threaten attempts to trip you and fails, it provokes an attack of opportunity from you. You must use your staff for this attack of opportunity.|HalfMythicLevel
